items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'well if you ever go to Kentucky, go go and see my Mother and Fater'.

ctx.x: Did every body take off on Derby Day? Would your father, would he be there? Or would people work use the same?

He worked just the hours he wanted to anyway, most of the time. He'd go out on Derby Day. Alot of times he would just come on home, you know, and just help make everybody comfortable. And I know when I got around and traveled I used to tell all my friends I'd meet, I said, 'well if you ever go to Kentucky, go go and see my Mother and Fater'. And they would and they would make me feel so nice.
And you mother and father were pleases.
